name: Medicine Ball Overhead Backward Throw
steps: Stand in a clear open space with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a medicine ball in front of your thighs.
Hinge smoothly back at your hips and bend your knees while dropping the ball between your legs.
Extend your hips, knees, and ankles explosively as you swing the ball upward and release it high backward over your head.
Land softly under balance, retrieve the ball safely, and reset cleanly before the next throw.
tips: Check that the space behind you is completely clear before every throw.
Drive powerfully through your hips and legs rather than arching excessively through your lower back.
